newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Hudson County, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Hudson County, N.J..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received, publicly opened and announced by the Director of Finance of the County of Hudson, New Jersey (the County'') at the Administration Annex, 2nd Floor, 567 Pavonia Avenue, Jersey City, New Jersey, on
until 11:00 a.m., at which time they will be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of the following Bonds of the County due on October 1 as follows:

All bidders for the Bonds must be participants of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''), or affiliated with its participants. Individual purchases may be made in the principal amount of $1,000 or any multiple thereof through book-entries made on the books and records of DTC and its participants. The Bonds will be dated October 1, 1996 and will bear interest at the single rate of interest per annum, specified by the successful bidder, with such interest payable on April 1, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on the first days of October and April in each year until maturity. The Bonds are not subject to redemption prior to their stated

maturities. The Bonds will be delivered on or about October 10, 1996 at the offices of the County's bond counsel, DeCotiis, Fitzpatrick & Gluck, in Trenton, New Jersey. A complete Notice of Sale containing the full terms of sale and the Preliminary Official Statement have each been prepared and may be obtained from Abraham Antun, Director of Finance, County of Hudson, New Jersey, Administration Annex, 2nd Floor, 567 Pavonia. Avenue, Jersey City, New Jersey, 07306, (201) 795-6068.
